title: Probe responses carry a stable JSON body shape with stable field names and an ISO-8601 timestamp
description: The liveness and readiness probe endpoints respond with a JSON body carrying a stable shape: a status field (one of pass or fail), a checkedAt field with an ISO-8601 timestamp of when the probe body was evaluated, and, on the readiness probe, a checks field mapping declared-dependency name to that dependency's individual pass/fail. Content-Type is application/json. Field names do not change across patch or minor versions of the blueprint; a change is a major version bump.
rationale: Probes get consumed by orchestrators, dashboards, and third-party monitoring integrations. A stable JSON shape with stable field names is what lets those consumers wire once and not re-wire on every deploy. HTTP status code drives routing decisions; the JSON body drives the operator's next diagnostic step.
